decision_outcomes.approve: Continue only the exact authorized effect and closed dependency set.
decision_outcomes.revise: Create new candidate epoch; reopen impacted preparation, checks, bundle and owner decisions.
decision_outcomes.defer: Preserve target and named owner route; dependent effect remains pending.
decision_outcomes.reject: Stop this target effect; no implied rejection or authorization of independent siblings.

retry_rule: Inspect after uncertain application; retry only the same exact proposal/authorization against the recorded committed receipt. Do not create a new approval timestamp as the same attempt.
concurrency_assumption: Owner-controlled cooperative writers and exact immutable epoch material. Arbitrary privileged external repository modification is not prevented by this scoped protocol.
